headline: Gold Drops Below $3,800 on US Rate Concerns and Firm Dollar
summary: Spot gold declined nearly 1.5% to break below $3,800 per ounce, sliding to multi-month lows after Federal Reserve officials indicated interest rates may need to remain elevated.
why: Gold is a non-yielding asset that faces downward pressure when sovereign bond yields and the US dollar strengthen.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Hawkish signals from Federal Reserve policymakers and a strengthening dollar triggered selling across precious metals.
